label: sranger ablation run-3 iter-1 cold codegen
summary: Full cold codegen of SRanger from canonical inputs: 9 Java files + result_codegen.json; all 22 requirements traced.

issues.title: Terminal mode named Stopped, not Final
issues.raw: CLAUDE.md mandates no Final state on the theory-generated controller; terminal mode is Stopped with a tick self-loop (bare-precondition operation). Behaviour unchanged: EndTask -> Stopped issues Move(0,0) and never leaves.
issues.fix_directive: Review whether renaming the SR-DM1/SR-FR3 'Final' mode to 'Stopped' is acceptable.

issues.title: No power-up actuator command in constructor
issues.raw: Initial Move(moveVel,0) entry action represented via entry-action lifting on transitions into Moving; constructor stays pure.
issues.fix_directive: Review whether a power-up Move command is required in Java.

issues.title: Extra tick self-loop on Stopped
issues.raw: Not in SR-Beh1..7; added for deadlock-freedom (bare-precondition operation on the terminal mode).
issues.fix_directive: Review; only Stopped transition, SR-DC1 still satisfied.

issues.title: Sensor no-reading default = 1000.0 m
issues.raw: Spec says 'a large default value'; 1000.0 chosen (>> obstacleThreshold 0.5).

issues.title: Obstacle transition gated on event AND predicate
issues.raw: Moving->Turning fires on Obstacle event (SR-Beh2) conjoined with obstacleDetected guard (SR-GP1).

issues.title: Clock units in seconds
issues.raw: Clock.now() returns seconds; turnDurationElapsed compares against TURN_DURATION = 2.0 s.
